title: Pig with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='33' ry='24' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='27' ry='17' fill='#ffb8d6'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='9' height='11' rx='4' fill='#e87aa8'/>
  <rect x='61' y='82' width='9' height='11' rx='4' fill='#e87aa8'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='89' width='9' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffd3e5'/>
  <rect x='61' y='89' width='9' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffd3e5'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M25 32 L20 15 L40 25 Z' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <path d='M75 32 L80 15 L60 25 Z' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <path d='M27 30 L24 20 L37 27 Z' fill='#ffc2dd'/>
  <path d='M73 30 L76 20 L63 27 Z' fill='#ffc2dd'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='27' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='22' fill='#ffb8d6'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='40' r='7' fill='#fff0f7'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='40' r='7' fill='#fff0f7'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#5a2d6b'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#5a2d6b'/>
  <circle cx='37.5' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='42.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='42.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ff7fb3'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='13' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#ffb8d6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='45.5' cy='54' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#8c2f5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='54.5' cy='54' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#8c2f5c'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 63 Q50 68 58 63' fill='none' stroke='#8c2f5c' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ff6fa8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ff6fa8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d='M82 60 Q90 56 87 50 Q84 45 79 49' fill='none' stroke='#e87aa8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
